subject: Medford High School Alternatives and Cost Analysis
overview: The Medford Comprehensive High School Building Committee reviewed the draft Preliminary Design Program (PDP) space summary, comparative cost estimates across 29 project options, design alternates, and a proposed communications plan. The committee approved meeting minutes, a project communications plan, January invoices, and a contract amendment, while a motion to request additional benchmarking and reimbursement studies failed.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The committee approved the meeting minutes from the January 14 full committee meeting and the January 28 subcommittee meeting.

items.title: Communications and Community Engagement Plan
items.summary: The committee reviewed and approved a feasibility-phase communications plan that outlines public outreach strategies, project meeting schedules, stakeholder analysis, and mailing list sign-ups.

items.title: January 2026 Invoices and Contract Amendment
items.summary: The committee approved $141,900 in January 2026 vendor invoices and approved Leftfield Amendment 1 in the amount of $17,600 for independent cost estimating services across the preliminary design and preferred schematic phases.

items.title: Recap of Alternatives Feedback
items.summary: Kimberly Talbot summarized the feedback and voting exercise results collected on design options from the January 14 meeting.

items.title: PDP Space Summary Review
items.summary: Architects and district leaders presented the Preliminary Design Program space summary detailing educational programming, classroom sizing, vocational space guidelines, and total square footage comparisons between new construction and renovation options.

items.title: Evaluation Criteria Matrix
items.summary: The team presented a draft evaluation matrix to guide the committee's upcoming weighting and scoring of the 29 design options during March meetings.

items.title: Comparative Cost Estimates and Alternates
items.summary: The committee reviewed high-level comparative project cost estimates for 29 design options ranging from roughly $850 million to $935 million, along with separate cost breakdowns for alternates involving parking structures, pool facilities, solar panel systems, and HVAC configurations.

items.title: Motion for Reimbursement and Benchmarking Reports
items.summary: A motion to request custom analytical artifacts detailing estimated space reimbursement ranges and comparing Medford's proposed square footage against recently built high schools in Waltham and Somerville failed.
